raw_posts.name: Naoma AI Demo Agent V2
raw_posts.tagline: Turns website traffic into booked, qualified meetings
raw_posts.description: Your book-a-demo button converts 1-2% of visitors. The rest leave. Naoma replaces the form with an AI account executive that runs the demo right then: it walks the prospect through your live product, answers questions, qualifies them and books the meeting. It remembers returning visitors, picks up where they left off, and writes every session back to your CRM. 50,000+ demos run for B2B SaaS teams. Now self-serve: upload your product and knowledge base test the agent today.

raw_posts.name: Web Search Agents by Nimble
raw_posts.tagline: Self-learning agents automate web research + retrieval
raw_posts.description: Web Search Agents are expert web crawling and research agents for your specific domain (company enrichment, regulations research, etc.). They self-learn your use case to go deeper into the sources that matter most to you, giving your AI deeper and more relevant web context. To get started, give your AI this link: https://docs.nimbleway.com/agent-onboarding.md

raw_posts.name: Elva
raw_posts.tagline: Goodbye, Postman. Your APIs have new consumers
raw_posts.description: Developers use your APIs. Now agents do too. Elva discovers APIs from code, lets you choose what each audience can use, and runs your MCP servers with auth and analytics. Track agent activity and review changes as your code evolves

raw_posts.name: Hello Inbox
raw_posts.tagline: Get more marketing emails into the inbox
raw_posts.description: Hello Inbox helps marketing teams get more emails into the inbox instead of spam. Test your campaigns before you send, see what is hurting deliverability, and get clear recommendations for what to fix. Instead of throwing deliverability scores and technical data at you, Hello Inbox turns the results into actionable steps so you can improve inbox placement without becoming an email deliverability expert.

raw_posts.name: Slashy Assistant
raw_posts.tagline: The AI assistant that does email for you
raw_posts.description: Slashy is an AI-native email client for managing all your inboxes. Slashy Assistant is the AI built into it: it drafts replies in your voice, organizes email, schedules meetings, prepares briefings, and tracks follow-ups. Connect your calendar, CRM, meeting notes, and favorite tools, and it starts helping within five minutes. Use it inside Slashy or through iMessage, Slack, or a phone call. Set up automations in plain English, and Slashy proactively handles recurring work before you have to ask.

raw_posts.name: Oats
raw_posts.tagline: Free, open-source, and on device meeting notetaker
raw_posts.description: Oats is an AI meeting note-taking tool that is completely open, local, and free. Designed to not get in the way of your meetings, no bots, no subscription needed when running locally with on-device LLM. Available on both macOS and Windows. Enhanced transcription, multi-language support, speaker recognition, assessment, coaching, auto-tracking follow ups and more features via ariso.ai cloud backend.

raw_posts.name: LLMagnet
raw_posts.tagline: Make your WordPress site visible to AI
raw_posts.description: LLMagnet gives WordPress sites an AI visibility layer. Track visits from ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini and other AI crawlers, measure your AI Visibility Score, generate llms.txt and structured data, and make your site readable and actionable for AI agents.

raw_posts.name: Aside
raw_posts.tagline: AI browser that actually gets work done for you
raw_posts.description: Aside is a browser rebuilt for people and agents. It signs into your accounts, uses websites directly, and finishes complex work: messages, payments, internal tools, even local files. - Crafted in every detail: vertical tabs and Liquid Glass. - SOTA on agentic browsing benchmarks: outperforms Claude Cowork. - Full privacy: everything runs locally and is encrypted. - You can use your Claude or ChatGPT subscription.

raw_posts.name: AppZapper 3000
raw_posts.description: The most fun uninstaller for macOS has been rebuilt for the 31st century. Introducing AppZapper 3000. Drag in any app and instantly find all of its extra files. Then delete them with a real 3D zapper.

raw_posts.name: OzBrain
raw_posts.tagline: Your knowledge shared with every AI agent & any teammate
raw_posts.description: Your Dropbox for agent knowledge (it works without you having to "work" it or maintain it.) Every agent you use reads and writes to the same brain, and so do your teammates and theirs. Start a new chat and it can know what you've all already worked on. Your IP, research, sci-fi romance novel or notes are encrypted and I won't train on it. Export it to markdown and leave whenever, because I think you shouldn't have your knowledge locked in anywhere, including OzBrain.
